title: Playboy Magazine March 1993 Mimi Rogers Anne Rice Interview Laura Dern
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, March 1993 issue. Cover price $4.95.

Features:
- Mimi Rogers: A Rapturous Pictorial - cover and pictorial
- Anne Rice defends erotica, boxing and vampires in a biting Playboy Interview
- Ron Ridenhour recalls the heroes at My Lai
- Erica Jong gets hot about modern love
- Strip clubs go upscale
- 20 Questions with Laura Dern
